# Historical evidence recovery: LS-01

This directory contains terminal decisions and proposed repairs for the 18 assigned parent IDs. `terminal-results.jsonl` is authoritative for each parent; `proposed-repairs.jsonl` contains the three supported partial drafts; `research-log.jsonl` records source checks, access limits, and non-corroboration.

The requested frozen record file `data/neon-export/tables/trump_entries.jsonl` was not present in the available repository checkouts. Existing September 2026 workbench snapshots are treated as leads, not canonical records or independent evidence. Six IDs had no event details in those snapshots and therefore remain unresolved. AP tracker claims are consolidated to one proposed card; the 2001 Miss USA allegation is not used to corroborate the separate 1997 Miss Teen USA/Ivanka claim; Legal News is only a lead; and 2025 commentary is not treated as proof of an alleged 2008 New York Times item.

Scores are editorial estimates, not measured harm. Unsupported event details, impact, intent, criminality, and Trump connections are not inferred. Source excerpts are kept with access method and limitation for review.
